parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name in each request.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Sources
parameters.description:
The information about the addresses of origin servers.

> Do not set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time. If you set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time, **TopLevelDomain** does not take effect.

parameters.name: TopLevelDomain
parameters.description:
The root domain. To add a root domain name, you must be added to the whitelist specified by the CDN_TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN_GREY_USER_LIST parameter.

> Do not set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time. If you set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time, **TopLevelDomain** does not take effect.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn modify-cdn-domain --domain-name example.com --sources content_:_1.1.1.1_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:80,_weight_:_15 --resource-group-id rg-acfmyuji4b6r400 --top-level-domain aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
